Name: Zadok, Father of Jerushah
Summary: Zadok was the father of Jerushah, mother of King Jotham; 2 Chronicles does not state whether he is Zadok the priest of David's day.
KeyStory: Zadok is named only as the father of Jerushah, Jotham's mother.
LifeLesson: A priestly name in a mother's line hints at a godly home.
